objective.mu_w_definition: mean across N fitting rows of the two-target absolute clipped-label weight sum

model: FP32 Linear224-64-GELU-Linear64-2 mean plus identical unused zero variance head

samplers.importance: with replacement, p_i=0.5/N + 0.5*g_i/sum_j(g_j), g_i fixed at common theta0
samplers.importance_weight: 1/(N*p_i), bounded by 2 by the uniform mixture floor
samplers.common_random_numbers: same U stream, arm-specific inverse CDF; sampled row sequences differ intentionally

fixed_theta0_uncentered_gradient_norm_se.interpretation: norm-only uncentered second moment, not variance or training-wide variance reduction

budget.batch_partition: 62 batches of 512 and one final batch of 64

scope_limit: one exposed R3 F0 panel; conditional fixed-step result, no fresh holdout or efficiency claim
